meta.name: description
meta.content: SVG logo code for Lifetok with a purple, black, sky-blue glitter night-sky background.

section.h1: Here is code for the logo you showed.
section.p: This is a single SVG logo with a dark night-sky background, purple symbol, and sky-blue glitter trail. You can save it as lifetok-logo.svg and use it on your website, splash screen, or app branding.

article.pre:
<svg viewBox="0 0 768 768" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Lifetok logo"> <defs> <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"> <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#020611"/> <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#07112b"/> </linearGradient>
<radialGradient id="glow1" cx="20%" cy="20%" r="40%"> <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#65dfff" stop-opacity=".14"/> <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#65dfff" stop-opacity="0"/> </radialGradient>
<radialGradient id="glow2" cx="80%" cy="12%" r="34%"> <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#b07cff" stop-opacity=".16"/> <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#b07cff" stop-opacity="0"/> </radialGradient>
<linearGradient id="purpleGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"> <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c597ff"/> <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#9f6eff"/> <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5f3bca"/> </linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="textGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"> <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c59cff"/> <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4f3da8"/> </linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="trailGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"> <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#65dfff" stop-opacity="0"/> <stop offset="25%" stop-color="#65dfff" stop-opacity=".95"/> <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#7ce7ff" stop-opacity=".95"/> <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#65dfff" stop-opacity="0"/> </linearGradient>
<filter id="softGlow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%"> <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8" result="blur"/> <feMerge> <feMergeNode in="blur"/> <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/> </feMerge> </filter>
<filter id="textGlow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%"> <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur"/> <feMerge> <feMergeNode in="blur"/> <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/> </feMerge> </filter>
<pattern id="stars" width="96" height="96" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"> <circle cx="12" cy="16" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity=".55"/> <circle cx="52" cy="20" r="1.2" fill="#9fdfff" opacity=".7"/> <circle cx="78" cy="44" r="0.9" fill="#ffffff" opacity=".45"/> <circle cx="34" cy="70" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity=".5"/> <circle cx="88" cy="84" r="1.1" fill="#9fdfff" opacity=".6"/> <circle cx="20" cy="56" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff" opacity=".4"/> </pattern> </defs>
<rect width="768" height="768" fill="url(#bgGrad)"/> <rect width="768" height="768" fill="url(#glow1)"/> <rect width="768" height="768" fill="url(#glow2)"/> <rect width="768" height="768" fill="url(#stars)" opacity=".9"/>
<g transform="translate(0,-8)"> <path d="M318 245 L352 278 L352 398 L318 409 Z" fill="url(#purpleGrad)" opacity=".95"/> <path d="M450 370 L484 382 L484 500 L450 488 Z" fill="url(#purpleGrad)" opacity=".95"/> <path d="M440 228 C474 254, 492 291, 489 326 C486 360, 460 388, 422 399 C384 410, 351 431, 329 468 C316 489, 305 508, 289 526 L274 516 C289 496, 301 477, 314 454 C336 414, 373 387, 414 373 C446 362, 466 342, 468 316 C470 289, 455 263, 426 238 Z" fill="url(#purpleGrad)" opacity=".97"/>
<path d="M327 228 C354 256, 382 284, 410 314 C434 340, 458 371, 478 406 C498 440, 511 473, 520 516 L500 520 C492 481, 480 449, 462 418 C441 381, 418 350, 394 324 C367 294, 340 267, 311 239 Z" fill="url(#purpleGrad)" opacity=".92"/>
<path d="M302 438 C276 420, 252 409, 227 405 C205 401, 184 406, 172 417 C157 430, 155 448, 162 465 C171 487, 191 503, 216 513 C249 526, 288 531, 325 530" fill="none" stroke="url(#purpleGrad)" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".92"/>
<path d="M514 261 C550 264, 585 271, 616 279 C637 284, 655 289, 676 295" fill="none" stroke="url(#trailGrad)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#softGlow)"/>
<path d="M195 459 C220 466, 248 470, 278 470 C308 470, 336 466, 362 460 C398 451, 428 429, 452 393 C474 360, 496 327, 525 303 C553 279, 586 266, 624 266" fill="none" stroke="url(#trailGrad)" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" filter="url(#softGlow)"/>
<g fill="#65dfff" filter="url(#softGlow)"> <circle cx="203" cy="459" r="1.6"/> <circle cx="212" cy="460" r="1.8"/> <circle cx="221" cy="462" r="1.4"/> <circle cx="235" cy="465" r="1.5"/> <circle cx="248" cy="467" r="1.2"/> <circle cx="333" cy="453" r="1.5"/> <circle cx="353" cy="449" r="1.7"/> <circle cx="378" cy="441" r="1.4"/> <circle cx="403" cy="426" r="1.5"/> <circle cx="430" cy="401" r="1.8"/> <circle cx="458" cy="367" r="1.8"/> <circle cx="485" cy="333" r="1.6"/> <circle cx="513" cy="306" r="1.5"/> <circle cx="544" cy="285" r="1.7"/> <circle cx="578" cy="273" r="1.5"/> <circle cx="606" cy="269" r="1.3"/> <circle cx="622" cy="268" r="1.2"/> <circle cx="542" cy="286" r="2.2"/> <circle cx="552" cy="286" r="1.4"/> <circle cx="564" cy="287" r="1.3"/> <circle cx="576" cy="288" r="1.2"/> <circle cx="588" cy="289" r="1.2"/> <circle cx="600" cy="290" r="1.1"/> </g> </g>
<text x="384" y="595" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="82" font-weight="700" fill="url(#textGrad)" filter="url(#textGlow)" letter-spacing="-2"> Lifetok </text> </svg>
article.div: Save the copied code in a file named lifetok-logo.svg. Then you can open it directly in your browser or import it into your design/app workflow.
